**Effective Date:** 9 October 2026  
**Website:** https://lovetechgroup.com.ng  
**Organisation:** Lovetech Agrofinance & Development Ltd
1. Introduction
Lovetech Agrofinance & Development Ltd, also referred to as “Lovetech,” “we,” “our,” or “us,” respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and protect your personal data when you visit our website, register for our Academy or LMS courses, complete forms, sign in using Google, make enquiries, book consultations, download resources, participate in programmes, or interact with any of our digital platforms.
By using our website and services, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.
2. Scope of this Policy
This Privacy Policy applies to:

items: Users who register or log in to the Lovetech Academy/LMS
Participants in our courses, training programmes, webinars, events, and consulting activities
Businesses that complete our finance readiness, diagnostic, or advisory forms
Users who contact us through WhatsApp, email, website forms, or social media links
Users who sign in using Google or other third-party authentication services
Individuals who download resources, templates, guides, or learning materials from our website

text: 3. Information We Collect
We may collect the following categories of personal and business information:
Personal Information

items: Gender or age range, where voluntarily provided
Google account profile information where you choose to sign in with Google, such as your name, email address, and profile image

text: Business Information

items: Monthly sales range or estimated turnover, where voluntarily provided
Funding needs or finance readiness information

text: Course and LMS Information
Technical Information
When you visit our website, we may automatically collect certain technical information, such as:
4. How We Collect Information
We collect information when you:

items: Complete a contact, diagnostic, registration, or application form
Make a payment or attempt to make a payment
Contact us by email, WhatsApp, phone, or social media
Participate in our training, consulting, or programme activities

text: 5. How We Use Your Information
We use your personal and business information for the following purposes:

items: To provide access to our website, LMS, courses, and digital resources
To create and manage your learner or user account
To process course registrations and programme applications
To deliver training, consulting, finance readiness, and business advisory services
To respond to your enquiries and provide customer support
To assess finance readiness or business support needs
To send course updates, reminders, resources, and relevant service information
To issue certificates, track course completion, and manage assignments
To improve our website, courses, tools, and services
To personalise user experience and recommend relevant services
To process payments through authorised payment providers
To comply with legal, regulatory, accounting, tax, audit, and reporting obligations
To protect our website, users, systems, and business from fraud, misuse, or security threats

text: 6. Legal Basis for Processing Personal Data
We process your personal data based on one or more lawful grounds, including:

items: Performance of a contract or provision of requested services
Compliance with legal or regulatory obligations
Protection of users, systems, and business operations
Public interest or programme reporting obligations, where applicable

text: You may withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, subject to legal, contractual, or operational limitations.
7. Google Sign-In
If you choose to sign in using your Google account, we may receive limited information from Google, such as your name, email address, and profile image, depending on the permissions you approve.
We use this information only to:

items: Create or authenticate your Lovetech account
Enable access to the LMS or website features
Communicate with you about your account, courses, or services

text: We do not receive or store your Google password.
8. Payments

Where payments are made through our website or linked payment platforms, your payment may be processed by third-party payment providers. We do not store your full card details or banking credentials on our website.
Payment providers may collect and process your payment information in accordance with their own privacy policies and security standards.
9. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to:

items: Understand how visitors use our website

text: You may disable cookies through your browser settings. However, some parts of the website may not function properly if cookies are disabled.
10. Sharing of Information
We do not sell your personal data.
We may share information with trusted third parties where necessary, including:

items: Consultants, facilitators, or programme partners working with us
Regulators, law enforcement agencies, or public authorities where required by law

text: Where we work with third-party service providers, we take reasonable steps to ensure they process data securely and only for authorised purposes.
11. International Data Transfers

Some third-party service providers we use may store or process data outside Nigeria. Where this occurs, we will take reasonable steps to ensure that your personal data is protected in line with applicable data protection requirements.
12. Data Retention

We retain personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including to provide services, meet legal and accounting requirements, resolve disputes, enforce agreements, and maintain course or programme records.
When personal data is no longer required, we will delete, anonymise, or securely archive it where appropriate.
13. Data Security
We take reasonable technical, administrative, and organisational measures to protect your personal information against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
However, no online platform can guarantee absolute security. Users are responsible for protecting their login details, passwords, devices, and account access.
14. Your Data Protection Rights
Subject to applicable law, you may have the right to:

items: Request access to your personal data
Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data
Request deletion of your personal data
Withdraw consent where processing is based on consent
Object to certain types of processing
Lodge a complaint with the appropriate data protection authority

text: To exercise your rights, contact us using the details provided below.
15. Children’s Privacy
Our website and services are generally intended for adults, entrepreneurs, professionals, organisations, and business users.
Where we provide programmes involving minors, we will require appropriate parental, guardian, school, or institutional consent before collecting or processing children’s personal information.
16. Links to Third-Party Websites

Our website may contain links to third-party websites, platforms, payment providers, social media pages, or external resources. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of third-party websites.
We encourage users to read the privacy policies of any external sites they visit.
17. Updates to this Privacy Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services, technology, legal requirements, or business operations.
The updated version will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.
18. Contact Us
For questions, requests, or complaints relating to this Privacy Policy or your personal data, contact:
